summary: Integration readiness brief — annunimas-human-tenant: project-specific check `git diff --exit-code HEAD --` passed with exit code 0. The migration notes also state that the original workspace member remains and compatibility removal is a follow-on gate. Shared integration risks are unresolved path coupling, duplicate compatibility surfaces, absent tenant runtime data, and lack of verified source-workspace compatibility evidence. Recommended operator action: in an authorized Annunimas workspace run the documented `target_local` check, then gate replacement of direct path dependencies and removal of the original workspace member on successful checks in both projects.
